log: The team picked the first 10 founders to reach and is finding a warm intro for each. Five new names per member are due this week.
Seven members submitted five founders each: 31 unique people and teams. We tightened the profile toward earlier founders based in the US.
Introduction to Norte and the pure-follower model. Every member wrote up their read of Norte before the meeting.
João Vitor Carvalho and João Camara set the profile, this page as the main output, and monthly meetings.
